questions.en: The guerrilla movement in the Philippines fought against the Japanese. What is their main reason?
questions.tl: Ang kilusang gerilya sa Pilipinas ay lumaban sa Hapones. Ano ang pangunahing dahilan nila?
questions.correct: Because of the love of the native land and the excessive cruelty of the Japanese to the Filipinos.
questions.correctTl: Dahil sa pag-ibig sa tinubuang lupa at labis na kalupitan ng mga Hapones sa mga Pilipino.
wrong: Because of the bribery of the Americans.
Because of the reward for every Japanese.
Because of the wealth of the Japanese.
wrongTl: Dahil sa panunuhol ng mga Amerikano.
Dahil sa pabuya sa bawat Hapones.
Dahil sa yaman ng mga Hapones.
questions.ex: The reason is the love of the people and the cruelty of the conqueror.
questions.exTl: Ang pag-ibig sa bayan at kalupitan ng mananakop ang dahilan.

questions.en: What do the Filipino guerrillas want to promote?
questions.tl: Ano ang nais isulong ng mga Pilipinong gerilya?
questions.correct: Ejecting the foreign invaders and achieving the desired freedom.
questions.correctTl: Pagpapatalsik sa mga dayuhang mananakop at pagkamit ng inaasam na kalayaan.
wrongTl: Pag-agaw ng kapangyarihan laban sa Amerikano.
questions.ex: The goal is freedom from foreign invaders.
questions.exTl: Kalayaan mula sa dayuhang mananakop ang layunin.

questions.en: How to defend the territorial integrity of the Philippines?
questions.tl: Paano ipagtatanggol ang integridad ng teritoryo ng Pilipinas?
questions.correct: The right and integrity of the Philippines can be upheld and defended in a peaceful manner consistent with international law.
questions.correctTl: Mapanindigan at maipagtanggol ang karapatan at integridad ng Pilipinas sa mapayapang paraang naaayon sa pandaigdigang batas.
wrong: Give up the claim of the Philippines.
questions.ex: This is the application of the struggle in the territorial issue.
questions.exTl: Ito ang aplikasyon ng pakikibaka sa usaping teritoryal.

questions.en: Which strategy was used to fight the Japanese?
questions.tl: Aling estratehiya ang ginamit upang labanan ang Hapones?
questions.correct: Used guerilla tactics so as not to be defeated and captured by the Japanese.
questions.correctTl: Gumamit ng taktikang gerilya upang hindi magapi at mahuli ng mga Hapones.
wrong: Formed an alliance recognized by Japan.
Formed a party to cooperate with Japan.
wrongTl: Bumuo ng alyansiyang kinikilala ng Hapon.
Bumuo ng partidong makikipagtulungan sa Hapon.
questions.ex: Guerrilla is irregular warfare against a larger army.
questions.exTl: Ang gerilya ay irregular na pakikidigma laban sa mas malaking hukbo.

questions.en: What is the best way for the common unarmed citizen to help against the Japanese?
questions.tl: Ano ang pinakamainam na paraan ng karaniwang mamamayang walang armas upang tumulong laban sa Hapones?
questions.correct: Cooperating with the guerrillas by providing food and information about the enemy.
questions.correctTl: Pakikiisa sa gerilya sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay ng pagkain at kaalaman tungkol sa kalaban.
wrongTl: Sumali sa Komisyong Tagapangasiwa ng Hapon.
questions.ex: Food and information are important civilian support.
questions.exTl: Pagkain at impormasyon ang mahalagang suporta ng sibilyan.

questions.en: Besides fighting, what methods were used to counter the Japanese?
questions.tl: Bukod sa pakikipaglaban, anong paraan ang ginamit upang kontrahin ang Hapones?
questions.correct: Establishment and formation of secret movements in towns and cities that supported the guerrillas.
questions.correctTl: Pagtatatag at pagbubuo ng mga lihim na kilusan sa bayan at lungsod na sumusuporta sa mga gerilya.
questions.ex: The secret movement provided support and aid to the guerrillas.
questions.exTl: Nagbigay ang lihim na kilusan ng suporta at tulong sa gerilya.

questions.en: Which advantage of the Igorot is related to being skilled in the mountains and forests?
questions.tl: Aling kalamangan ng Igorot ang kaugnay ng pagiging bihasa sa kabundukan at kagubatan?
questions.correct: Knowledge of the terrain.
questions.correctTl: Kaalaman ng kalupaan.
questions.ex: Terrain knowledge directly refers to the tunnels.
questions.exTl: Ang terrain knowledge ang direktang tumutukoy sa mga lagusan.

questions.en: What was the effect of the combined advantage of the Igorot against the Japanese?
questions.tl: Ano ang naging epekto ng pinagsanib na kalamangan ng Igorot laban sa Hapones?
questions.correct: Lot and retreat of the Japanese in the battles.
questions.correctTl: Pagkatalo at pag-atras ng mga Hapones sa mga labanan.
questions.ex: The advantages of the Igorot helped the retreat of the Japanese.
questions.exTl: Nakatulong ang mga kalamangan ng Igorot sa pag-atras ng Hapones.

questions.en: What would be the consequences if the Igorot did not cooperate with the Americans?
questions.tl: Ano ang kahihinatnan kung hindi nakiisa ang Igorot sa mga Amerikano?
questions.correct: Prolongation of the battle and an increase in the casualties of the American soldiers.
questions.correctTl: Paghaba ng labanan at pagdami ng nasawing sundalong Amerikano.
questions.ex: The knowledge and cooperation of the Igorot in the Cordillera is important.
questions.exTl: Mahalaga ang kaalaman at pakikiisa ng Igorot sa Cordillera.

questions.en: What was the unique role of women during the Second World War?
questions.tl: Ano ang bukod-tanging papel ng kababaihan noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig?
questions.correct: They became officers and commanders of the Filipino guerrilla army who fought in the front line of the war.
questions.correctTl: Naging opisyal at kumander ng hukbong gerilyang Pilipino na sumabak sa unang hanay sa digmaan.
questions.ex: There were women who became officers and commanders of the guerrillas.
questions.exTl: May kababaihang naging opisyal at kumander ng gerilya.

questions.en:
Statement I: Becoming a woman leader in an army of men is easy, quick, and immediate.

Statement II: She must earn the confidence and trust of the soldiers she leads, and this cannot be gained immediately.

Which statement evaluation is correct?
questions.tl:
Pahayag I: Ang pagiging pinuno ng isang babae sa hukbo ng mga kalalakihan ay madali, mabilis, at biglaan.

Pahayag II: Kailangan niyang makuha ang kumpiyansa at tiwala ng mga sundalong kanyang pinamumunuan at hindi ito basta-basta nagagawa nang agaran.

Alin ang tamang pagsusuri?
questions.correct: The first sentence is wrong and the second is right.
questions.correctTl: Mali ang unang pangungusap at tama ang ikalawa.
wrong: The first is right, the second is wrong.
wrongTl: Tama ang una, mali ang ikalawa.
questions.ex: It takes training, experience and confidence to lead.
questions.exTl: Kailangan ang pagsasanay, karanasan at tiwala upang mamuno.

questions.en: What should a soldier see in a female leader?
questions.tl: Ano ang dapat makita ng sundalo sa pinunong babae?
questions.correct: She is truly a worthy leader without a trace of fear or doubt.
questions.correctTl: Tunay siyang karapat-dapat na pinuno na walang bahid ng pagkatakot o pag-aalinlangan.
wrong: She will insist on being the leader.
questions.ex: Trust comes from ability and courage.
questions.exTl: Tiwala ang nakukuha sa kakayahan at katapangan.

questions.en: What is the biased belief of Hukbalahap?
questions.tl: Ano ang kinikilingang paniniwala ng Hukbalahap?
questions.correct: Communist Ideology.
questions.correctTl: Ideolohiyang Komunista.
questions.ex: The communist reviewer records the biased ideology of Hukbalahap.
questions.exTl: Itinatala ng reviewer na komunista ang kinikilingang ideolohiya ng Hukbalahap.

questions.en: Which are the Communist symbols: red star, red flag, hammer and crowbar, sun with eight rays?
questions.tl: Alin ang mga simbolong Komunista: pulang bituin, pulang bandila, martilyo at kumpay, araw na may walong sinag?
questions.correct: Red star, red flag, and hammer and crowbar.
questions.correctTl: Pulang bituin, pulang bandila, at martilyo at kumpay.
wrong: Red star, red flag, and sun with eight rays.
Red flag, hammer and crowbar, and sun with eight rays.
Red star, hammer and crowbar, and sun with eight rays.
wrongTl: Pulang bituin, pulang bandila, at araw na may walong sinag.
Pulang bandila, martilyo at kumpay, at araw na may walong sinag.
Pulang bituin, martilyo at kumpay, at araw na may walong sinag.
questions.ex: The sun with eight rays is not a symbol of communism ray
questions.exTl: Hindi simbolo ng komunismo ang araw na may walong sinag.

questions.en: What does the red star symbolize?
questions.tl: Ano ang sinasagisag ng pulang bituin?
questions.correct: Workers, farmers, and youth.
questions.correctTl: Manggagawa, magsasaka, at kabataan.
questions.ex: The red star does not represent the politician.
questions.exTl: Ang pulang bituin ay hindi kumakatawan sa politiko.

questions.en: What did the Igorot defend in the Battle Pockets?
questions.tl: Ano ang ipinagtatanggol ng Igorot sa Labanang Pockets?
questions.correct: Freedom, culture, and territory.
questions.correctTl: Kalayaan, kultura, at teritoryo.
questions.ex: They fought for their ancestral land, freedom, and culture.
questions.exTl: Ipinaglaban nila ang kanilang lupaing ninuno, kalayaan, at kultura.

questions.en: What is the goal of the Igorots in fighting?
questions.tl: Ano ang layunin ng mga Igorot sa pakikipaglaban?
questions.correct: Defend the ancestral land, maintain freedom, and resist the Japanese occupation.
questions.correctTl: Ipagtanggol ang lupain ng ninuno, panatilihin ang kalayaan, at labanan ang pananakop ng Hapones.
questions.ex: They defended territory, culture and freedom.
questions.exTl: Teritoryo, kultura at kalayaan ang ipinagtanggol nila.

questions.en: What does the Igorot's courage, stability and knowledge of nature prove?
questions.tl: Ano ang pinapatunayan ng tapang, katatagan at kaalaman ng Igorot sa kalikasan?
questions.correct: The strong unity and stability of the Igorot inspired the formation of the guerrilla group.
questions.correctTl: Ang matinding pagkakaisa at katatagan ng Igorot ay naging inspirasyon sa pagbuo ng pangkat-gerilya.
wrong: They only acted in a calm manner.
They only hunted in the plains.
questions.ex: The Igorot guerrilla showed unity and stability.
questions.exTl: Pagkakaisa at katatagan ang ipinakita ng gerilyang Igorot.

questions.en:
Statement I: Kumander Liwayway saved her troops and defeated Japanese forces in the Battle of Mandili in Candaba, Pampanga.

Statement II: The Battle of Mandili proved that a woman leader can lead successfully.

Which statement evaluation is correct?
questions.tl:
Pahayag I: Nasagip ni Kumander Liwayway ang kanyang mga tauhan at nagapi ang puwersa ng mga Hapon sa Labanan sa Mandili, Candaba, Pampanga.

Pahayag II: Napatunayan sa Labanan sa Mandili na kayang mamuno nang matagumpay ang babaeng pinuno.

Alin ang tamang pagsusuri?
questions.correct: The first sentence is incorrect and the second is correct.
questions.correctTl: Mali ang unang pangungusap at tama ang ikalawa.
wrong: The first sentence is correct, the second is incorrect.
wrongTl: Tama ang una, mali ang ikalawa.
questions.ex: Felipa Culala or Commander Dayang-Dayang was associated with the Battle of Mandili.
questions.exTl: Si Felipa Culala o Kumander Dayang-Dayang ang iniugnay sa Labanan sa Mandili.

questions.en: What does the Hunters ROTC consider the Town of Parañaque?
questions.tl: Ano ang turing ng Hunters ROTC sa Bayan ng Parañaque?
questions.correct: Area of ​​Operation.
questions.correctTl: Area of Operation.
questions.ex: Hunters ROTC considers Parañaque as an Area of ​​Operation.
questions.exTl: Itinuring ng Hunters ROTC ang Parañaque bilang Area of Operation.
